scope: session write model stop-gap: single commit boundary, session-level CAS, single-instance file lock, busy/locked retry, orphan backfill, resume trace source
external_call_scope: 跨进程/跨实例写等待的总预算：文件锁获取 + busy/locked 退避累计 + SQLite busy_timeout。本地单次 SQLite 写不算外部调用；provider 流式与子进程超时豁免沿用 .dev-team/nfr-baseline.json 既有条目，本文件不改写全局基准。

retry.retry_on_source: rusqlite::Error::SqliteFailure(err, _) where err.code in {rusqlite::ErrorCode::DatabaseBusy, rusqlite::ErrorCode::DatabaseLocked} (rusqlite 0.31 / libsqlite3-sys 0.30，实测 SQLITE_BUSY | SQLITE_LOCKED)
retry.forbidden_heuristic: error.to_string().contains("busy")  —— 对 "database is locked" 永不匹配，现为死分支（sqlite_session.rs:2661 / :2687）

single_instance_file_lock.semantics: 独占非阻塞获取：Unix flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) / Windows LockFileEx 独占；获取失败即降级只读并在 UI 明示，禁止忙等或抢占
single_instance_file_lock.on_denied: 只读态 + 结构化日志 single_instance_lock_denied，禁止写库

session_cas.guard: UPDATE ... WHERE version = ?expected（changes() = 1 才算提交成功）
session_cas.expected_version_source: PersistedStore.versions[b]（SessionVersionMap）中的期望值，由读取侧携带到提交侧
session_cas.on_mismatch: CommitOutcome::StaleVersion { expected, actual } 且零写入（不覆盖、不删除、不复活）
